integrity: An analytic tight-graph rank and connectivity proof covers every allowed parameter; twelve exact finite test cases supplement it. Literature comparison includes the prior complete-multipartite graph metric endpoint and two-part interpolation.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar spaces, at least three nonempty parts, uniform cross-part distance and one intra-part distance parameter. The \(t=1\) and \(t=2\) endpoint counts are prior or elementary; only the strict-interior classification is new. Independent review is absent.
title: Sharp facet jumps for interpolated complete-multipartite Lipschitz-free balls
